openQuestions: Syllabus units follow the UPSC items; Section A/B labels are not separate fields (schema has none). Paper 1 Section B 'Principal Organs' (a) Union and (b) State are merged into one unit. Owner may want sections shown.
Node splits are our own choice (67 nodes in Paper 1, 43 in Paper 2); some, such as the Western thinkers, could be merged if the owner prefers fewer nodes.
Political Theory: meaning and approaches is split into two nodes (p1-01 meaning, p1-02 approaches); the six theories of the state are paired into three nodes (p1-03 to p1-05).

Hindi terms chosen: उपागम (approach), प्राधान्य (hegemony), सकारात्मक कार्रवाई (affirmative action), पश्च-औपनिवेशिक (post-colonial), नया उदारवाद (new liberalism, to keep it apart from नव-उदारवाद, neo-liberalism). Hindi editor to confirm against UPSC's Hindi syllabus.
No quotations are used; well-known lines (Laslett, Communist Manifesto, Ambedkar 25 November 1949) are paraphrased and listed in factsToCheck.
Links use made-up slugs (psir/..., gs2/...) for Claude Code to map.
